What we make

Every piece is measured at your home, built to fit your space, and finished by hand. Starting rates below follow current Delhi NCR market rates (material + labour, installed), checked in November 2026 — the final quote depends on material and size. You can also bring the material yourself — then you pay labour charges only. The estimator below shows both ways.

Modular Kitchens

BWP plywood cabinets, soft-close channels, tandem drawers and premium laminates — designed around your cooking style.

₹1,400 / sq.ft onwards (laminate)

Wardrobes & Storage

Sliding or hinged wardrobes, loft covering, shoe racks and crockery units with smart internal layouts.

₹1,200 / sq.ft onwards

Beds & Furniture

Solid sheesham and teak beds with storage, dining sets, study tables, sofas frames and custom furniture of every kind.

₹22,000 / bed onwards

Doors & Windows

Main doors with carving, flush doors, window frames and safety grills — fitted with quality hinges and locks.

₹8,500 / door onwards (installed)

TV Units & Wall Panels

Floating TV units, fluted wall panels, partitions and pooja units that give your living room a finished look.

₹1,100 / sq.ft onwards

Repair, Polish & Renovation

Old furniture repair, hinge and channel replacement, re-polish and full home woodwork renovation.

₹299 / visit onwards

Send this on WhatsApp

How to read these rates: per-sq.ft rates are on front area (width × height) for wardrobes, TV units, bookshelves and similar units — ceiling area for wooden ceilings and wall area for panelling. All-in rates include material + labour and installation, before GST. Labour-only rates, when you supply the material: wardrobe ₹240–350/sq ft, kitchen ₹275–450/sq ft, TV unit ₹220–350/sq ft, general furniture making ₹300–550/sq ft (Sainik710 carpenter rate guide). Not included: kitchen appliances, chimney and countertop, bed mattress, and premium door hardware. Polish rates vary widely with coats and condition, solid-teak work is priced on design, and the repair-visit charge is a starting charge — a few items are quoted only after a free site visit because no fixed market rate exists for them. Rate sources (checked November 2026): Sainik710 Carpenter Rate Guide, HouseGyan, InteriorCalculator, Studio Matrx, HouseYog and Eagle Decor (Delhi NCR).
